The arithmetic is the deterrent: 429 fakes pay 429 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. A velvet of doubt is healthy, a pearl of proof is required, and a garden of patience is the price of a clean panel. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
